name: card_case3
purpose: Case example card for a career-consulting landing page (example, not a real testimonial)
layout: A single white card with a thick yellow (#f6c90e) border and a yellow offset shadow, on a pale sky-blue (#d3e4ee) page background. From top to bottom: (1) two-line bold headline in navy (#1f3a57), the part given as 'orange' written in orange (#d2562a) with a hand-drawn wavy orange underline; (2) a wide landscape photograph: a Japanese woman in her mid 20s in a white blouse at a laptop in a bright office, gentle smile, with a small navy label tag at its bottom-right corner containing the caption; (3) centered banner text with a yellow marker highlight and sparkle stars on both sides; (4) a simple bar chart: on the left a short grey gradient bar with a small white pill label above it and a caption below it, on the right a tall orange gradient bar with a small white pill label above and a caption below, a big yellow-orange arrow pointing up-right between the bars, and a navy round badge with white border at the right edge overlapping the chart showing the badge text; (5) a short paragraph in dark text with the key phrase in orange; (6) a tiny grey footnote at the bottom.

text_blocks.headline_line2: もう一度仕事を選び直す
text_blocks.photo_caption: 相談例③ 20代 女性（イメージ）
text_blocks.banner: 第二新卒として転職活動へ
text_blocks.paragraph: 1年足らずで辞めたことが引っかかっていました。辞めた理由の言い方を一緒に練習して、面接前に何度でも言い直せる状態にします。
text_blocks.footnote: ※相談の進め方のイメージです。結果をお約束するものではありません。

style: Japanese landing-page section graphic, flat vector UI layout combined with a natural photograph, crisp heavy Japanese gothic (bold sans-serif) lettering, high contrast, clean, professional advertising quality, mobile-first
text_rule: Render every Japanese string EXACTLY as given in text_blocks, character by character, with correct kanji/hiragana/katakana. Do not add any other text, numbers, logos or watermark. Text must be sharp and legible.
